changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO base_permissions (name, code, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT seed.name, seed.code, sm.id, TRUE FROM ( SELECT 'Ver suscripción' AS name, 'subscription.read' AS code, 'SUBSCRIPTION' AS sub_module_code UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver cotizaciones de suscripción', 'quote.read', 'QUOTE' UNION ALL SELECT 'Aceptar cotización de suscripción', 'quote.accept', 'QUOTE' UNION ALL SELECT 'Rechazar cotización de suscripción', 'quote.reject', 'QUOTE' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver documentos de cobro de suscripción', 'subscriptionBilling.read', 'SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING' ) seed JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.code = seed.sub_module_code LEFT JOIN base_permissions existing ON existing.code = seed.code WHERE existing.id IS NULL;
INSERT INTO base_role_permissions (base_role_id, base_permission_id, enabled) SELECT br.id, bp.id, TRUE FROM base_roles br JOIN base_permissions bp ON bp.code IN ( 'subscription.read', 'quote.read', 'quote.accept', 'quote.reject', 'subscriptionBilling.read') WHERE br.code = 'ADMIN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM base_role_permissions existing WHERE existing.base_role_id = br.id AND existing.base_permission_id = bp.id);

rollback.sql:
DELETE FROM base_role_permissions WHERE base_permission_id IN ( SELECT id FROM base_permissions WHERE code IN ( 'subscription.read', 'quote.read', 'quote.accept', 'quote.reject', 'subscriptionBilling.read'));
DELETE FROM base_permissions WHERE code IN ( 'subscription.read', 'quote.read', 'quote.accept', 'quote.reject', 'subscriptionBilling.read');
